axes.title: Buttons
axes.headline: Default heights spread across 28–56px, and even the mode (40px) covers only ~23%. There is no standard height.

axes.title: Typography
axes.headline: Base body size splits into six camps (13·14·16·17·18·24). The 14px camp is the largest, at 17 samples.

axes.title: Color & contrast
axes.headline: How palettes are organised. Contrast is computed with the WCAG formula — never eyeballed.

axes.title: Forms & inputs
axes.headline: About 30 systems match input height to button height. Checkboxes converge on 16px; GOV.UK breaks it at 40px.

axes.title: Modals
axes.headline: The modal-width mode sits in the 450–520px band, with 512px right in the middle of it.

axes.title: Motion
axes.headline: prefers-reduced-motion handling splits into nine layers across 17 systems. scroll-behavior counts as motion too.

axes.title: Tables
axes.headline: Cell padding, row height, density, borders, sticky headers. A thin-sample axis.

axes.title: Navigation
axes.headline: Sidebar, tab and breadcrumb dimensions and structure. A thin-sample axis.

axes.title: Feedback
axes.headline: Severity systems for alerts, toasts and badges. "Banners never auto-dismiss" is unanimous at 8/8.

guides.title: system-selection
guides.desc: Picks reference systems that fit the product's coordinates — platform, viewing distance, locale, domain.

guides.title: design-review
guides.desc: Reviews a mockup or an implementation against corpus evidence. Three verdicts: convergence deviation / accepted divergence / internal inconsistency.

guides.title: event-instrumentation
guides.desc: Reads UX context out of Figma or code and proposes an analytics event sheet.

guides.title: localization
guides.desc: Reads strings and their context out of code or Figma, then localises them.

profiles.desc: Wall / TV at 3m · 60/80pt overscan · typography left empty (U)
